definitions.explanation: An accommodation option where only the room is provided, with no meals included.

examples.japanese: {素泊|すど}まりプランは{安|やす}い。
{食事|しょくじ}は{外|そと}で{食|た}べるので、{素泊|すど}まりにした。
examples.english: Since I'll eat out, I chose room-only lodging.

examples.japanese: {素泊|すど}まり{一泊|いっぱく}5000{円|えん}。
examples.english: Room-only rate is 5000 yen per night.

notes:
FORMATION:
{素|す} (plain/bare) + {泊|と}まり (staying)

ACCOMMODATION OPTIONS:
・{素泊|すど}まり - room only (no meals)
・{朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き - with breakfast
・{夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}き - with dinner
・{一泊|いっぱく}{二食付|にしょくつ}き - one night with two meals
・{二食付|にしょくつ}き - with two meals (dinner and breakfast)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{素泊|すど}まりプラン - room-only plan
・{素泊|すど}まり{料金|りょうきん} - room-only rate
・{素泊|すど}まりで{泊|と}まる - to stay room-only

USAGE NOTE:
Common when booking ryokan (Japanese inns) or minshuku (guesthouses), where meals are traditionally included in the standard rate.
